instruction: Running `python3 -m pytest tests/ --collect-only` aborts with two collection errors: tests/test_auth_sidecar.py and tests/test_kokoro_gateway.py both import fastapi at module level, and fastapi is not installed on this machine. Two files failing to import must not stop the other 731 tests from being collected. Change both files so that when fastapi is unavailable the whole module is SKIPPED cleanly instead of erroring, using `pytest.importorskip` with a reason explaining that fastapi is required. The importorskip call must come before any fastapi import, and the original `from fastapi.testclient import TestClient` line must be removed in favour of obtaining TestClient after the skip check. When fastapi IS installed the tests must run exactly as they do now - do not delete, weaken or change any test logic, and do not wrap imports in try/except. Change only those two files.
